_comment: Shape: flat { string: string } map. Reserved keys start with _. _owner = the node owner's user id (the RIVETOS_USER_ID value that still means the owner). _comment is documentation, not a user. Other keys map user ids to profile basenames (users/<profile>.md). On first contact with a new routed id, add "<id>": "<id>" and create users/<id>.md from USER-TEMPLATE.md. Keep in sync as you learn names. A missing or empty map is fail-safe: never lock anyone out, never disclose owner context to a guest.
